scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:database" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:backend
scripts.clean:frontend: cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json dist
